_comment: SC flight model (flight_core::sc::drive::DriveTuning). TODO(initiator): every value. boost_capacitor (drain_time, recharge_time, recharge_delay s, start_charge, strength_curve (charge, share of the full boost), restart_while_held); boost_thrust: multipliers on the thrust per direction at full boost (the brake always gets them). spool_delay: s per thruster group (main forward, retro backward, vertical up and down, lateral left and right) that a fresh request waits before thrust; a running boost skips it; the timer resets when the request returns to zero. jerk: m/s³ per group, how fast a group's thrust may change (time to full = spool + full/jerk). angular_jerk: rad/s³ per pitch, yaw, roll. boost_pre_delay: s from the press to the boost start; boost_ramp_up / boost_ramp_down: s to full strength after the start, and to none after release. boost_counter_share: 0..1, countering boost (against the velocity on an axis) gets this share of the aligned boost at full boost; unboosted countering is the plain box. idle_cost: charge 0..1 per s drained while boost is held, with or without thrust, on top of the capacitor's drain. Values of 2026-10-10 derived from a small Star Citizen fighter's flight records (initiator: "nimm die werte aus sc und passe sie an unser projekt an"): times, rates and ratios taken over, speeds scaled to our 150 m/s SCM cap, mass kept at our 2 t; nothing copied 1:1. Still TODO(initiator) by feel. capacitor: 20 s of boost (capacity over the idle cost), 26.7 s to refill (over the regen), 0.2 s delay, starts at 25 %; boost_thrust x1.5 forward, x1.2 the rest; jerk = acceleration over SC's 0.2 s jerk time (angular 0.1 s); boost ramp 0.6 s up, 0.3 s down, no pre-delay. spool_delay stays ours (from captures, not in the records).
